statement: Pinned libxwiimote validates that its HID parent has kernel driver name 'wiimote' and discovers separately named Wii core, acceleration, IR, MotionPlus, and accessory evdev children. Its MotionPlus interface open is O_RDONLY (or O_RDWR in writable mode) on the node, not hidraw and not Bluetooth pairing. Consequently any driver-bound UHID-Bluetooth instance with the expected HID parent and named children is a source-supported discovery candidate; uinput-only nodes without matching hid-wiimote HID parent are not direct libxwiimote candidates.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
